assessment: The article presents a first example of a detailed quantitative study of host and PRRSV gene expression over the time course of infection. The study not only identifies multiple non-canonical mechanisms of PRRSV gene expression regulation, but also shows that the frameshifting efficiency at the canonical ORF1ab frameshifting site changes with time. This finding provides new insights into the viral gene expression and into the regulation of programmed ribosome frameshifting, which has important implications for understanding viral biology and for developing antiviral drugs.
